sources.birth: Original F124-AJ source generator with cohort-only rebinding and source-first verified pair birth; then inverse prior AJ transform and apply new prospectively frozen non-permutation operators; exact public demos independent of graph bits and matched per label.
sources.public_demo_identity: Deterministically independent 16-bit support inputs using new F124AK source seed, vector and task namespace, identical positive/negative support per pair.
sources.validity: New relation after inverse original raw source input, single positive and no negative under new inverse relation; no old source-key equality path, all public query and edge token multisets balanced.
sources.first_use: TRAIN labels only for selection, unseen HOLDOUT relation values and class labels untouched until all choices frozen.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Can a small but explicit generic hypothesis learner infer NON-permutation/non-per-bit-XOR relations including carry-generating addition and reversible triangular AND couplings from just 4–24 public input/output support pairs?
Yggdrasil.learner_hypotheses: Add constant modulo 2^16; reversible triangular transform out_i=in_i XOR (in_(i-p) AND in_(i-q)) for indices i>=q, plus an inferred optional output XOR mask, p in 1..4 q in p+1..5. Candidate generated and independently verified against public demos; require unique mapping across candidate family, abort on ties. No true class labels or rule identity in inference.
Yggdrasil.selected_rule: Max paired accuracy 48 new TRAIN only, ties fewer demos, compare against original AJ-only permutation+XOR learner (which should fail correctly), raw original AG and oracle-only perfect-known-transform ceiling.
Yggdrasil.score: Keep original historical F124-AG eta0.1, unchanged seven active/nine retained, frozen weights
Yggdrasil.limits: A hand-designed operator-family hypothesis class with in-context inference, NOT autonomous learning outside trained hypothesis family.

Wingless.hypothesis: Within-chain competitive transition evidence using the original single packed 12-bit code per node may distinguish a useful causal continuation from distractors better than original unconditioned match score.
Wingless.mechanism: After source-blind in-context operation inference on 24 public demonstrations, retain original packed one state per node. Update each candidate value and rank at each hop with beta times (the candidate packed-key match minus strongest alternative packed-key match from same prior retained node and hop), with beta=0 bit-identical to original. No extra retained per-node bits or states; transient candidate comparisons and additional time are measured.
Wingless.fit: Choose beta on independent new TRAIN 48 only, tie prefer beta0. First HOLDOUT after betas frozen. Source-blind numeric diagnostic plus evaluator-only true-path proxy loss.
